authorship: Independently authored normative group-scalar prohibition and record-selection controls; preserves the historical conflicting private fixture separately.

row-group-key-unreached-branch.specification:
schema_version: '1.0'
domain: TEST
keys: [ID]
input: {SRC: {path: input.csv, types: {V: int}}}
output: {path: result.csv, columns: [ID, VALUE]}
columns: [{name: ID, type: str, derivation: SRC.ID}, {name: VALUE, type: str}]
rows:
  - id: grouped
    dataset: SRC
    group_by: [SRC.ID]
    derivations:
      VALUE: {case: [{when: 'FALSE', then: {source: {variable: SRC.ID, filter: 'SRC.V > 0'}}}, {otherwise: {literal: unused}}]}
